## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie.md)

[Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) Mayes's life is saved by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she contracts a severe case of croup in Volume 1. [Anne](../character/anne.md) steps in to treat the illness and successfully manages her symptoms until doctor assistance arrives, creating a profound debt of gratitude between the Mayes family and [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
